_comment: Copy to config/checks.json, which is git-ignored. The list of hostnames to probe is NOT here — it is derived from data/servers.json, so a site deployed today is checked today. This file holds only what cannot be derived: where to send the report, and which forms may be submitted.

webhookHeaders._comment: Optional. If the n8n webhook uses header auth, put it here. This file is git-ignored, so a token is safe — but it never reaches data/ or the dashboard.

_notify_comment: One address or a list. The webhook payload carries both `to` (comma-separated, what most email nodes want) and `toList` (an array, for the ones that want that). `cc` works the same way and is optional.
_notify_todo: Proving it end to end first, so only one inbox gets the noise. Add mdo60@kwgroup.in and mm3@kwgroup.in to `notify` once a real report has arrived.
_forms_comment: A form is submitted ONLY if it appears here. Every run posts a real submission to a real CRM, so each entry is a deliberate decision. `fields` maps YOUR field names to the placeholders name/email/phone/message; any other value is sent literally. `expect` is a string the response must contain — without it, any 2xx counts as success, and a form that 200s while silently dropping the lead is exactly the failure worth catching.
